title: Proper direct image preserves arbitrary coproducts
statement: Let $A$ be a finite commutative ring, and let $r:V\to T$ be a proper morphism [def-weil-proper-morphism] of finite type between Noetherian schemes (locally Noetherian [pqf-def-locnoeth] and quasi-compact [def-weil-pbc-quasi-compact-scheme]). On the ordinary unbounded derived categories $D(V_{\Et},A)$ and $D(T_{\Et},A)$ [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], the total right derived direct image $Rr_*$ preserves arbitrary set-indexed coproducts. Its bounded-below restriction is the derived direct image of [def-weil-pbc-direct-image].

proof.text: Apply [pqf-lem-proper-basic] to $r$: it is quasi-compact, quasi-separated and of finite type. The base $T$ is quasi-compact by the Noetherian hypothesis in the statement. Apply [lem-fin-finite-type-fibre-dimension-bound] to $r$ to obtain an integer $e\geq0$ bounding the dimensions of every scheme-theoretic fibre $V_t$; empty fibres are allowed. No absolute dimension bound on either Noetherian scheme is used.

There are integers $0\leq i<j$ with $i1_A=j1_A$, since $A$ is finite. Put $N=j-i>0$. Then $N1_A=0$, so for every module sheaf $M$ and every section $s$, $Ns=(N1_A)s=0$. Put $F=U_VM$. In [def-weil-pbc-torsion-etale-sheaf], $F[N]=F$. Write $j_n:F[n]\to\varinjlim_mF[m]$ for the colimit maps and $c_F$ for the canonical map to $F$. Then $c_Fj_N=\mathrm{id}_F$. For every $n$, put $l=\operatorname{lcm}(n,N)$. We have $F[l]=F$, the transition $F[N]\to F[l]$ is the identity, and the transition $F[n]\to F[l]$ is its inclusion into $F$. Cocone compatibility therefore gives $j_Nc_Fj_n=j_l(F[n]\hookrightarrow F[l])=j_n$. The colimit universal property gives $j_Nc_F=\mathrm{id}$, proving that $F$ is torsion by the cited definition. Apply [lem-kun-proper-torsion-cd-bound] to $r$, $e$ and $U_VM$. It gives $R^ar_*U_VM=0$ for $a>2e$. By [lem-sbc-higher-direct-image-forget-comparison], this is the underlying abelian sheaf of $R^ar_*M$. A module sheaf whose underlying abelian sheaf is zero has zero sections on every site object, hence is zero. Thus $R^ar_*M=0$ for every $A$-module sheaf $M$ and every $a>2e$.

proof.text: Apply [lem-exc-direct-image-coproducts] with $u=r$, the given finite ring $A$, and $c=2e$. Step 1 verifies quasi-compactness and quasi-separatedness, and Step 2 gives its vanishing hypothesis for every module sheaf, without constructibility or an invertibility restriction. Its conclusion states that $Rr_*$ preserves arbitrary coproducts on the unbounded ordinary derived categories, exactly the assertion. The finite acyclic-resolution argument is carried by that existing lemma; no bounded-below spectral-sequence convergence is being assumed for an unbounded input. For the final bounded-below compatibility clause, apply [src-right-derived-functor-plus-compatibility] to the additive direct image between the abelian categories of constant A-module sheaves. The enough-injectives and K-injective resolution structures are those used in [def-weil-pbc-direct-image]. The resulting natural isomorphism identifies the bounded-below right derived functor, followed by its inclusion, with the restriction of the total right derived functor.

theorem proper_rightDerivedLowerStar_preservesCoproducts
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A]
    {V T : Scheme.{u}} (r : V ⟶ T) [IsProper r]
    [IsLocallyNoetherian V] [CompactSpace V] [IsLocallyNoetherian T] [CompactSpace T] :
    (∀ I : Type w, PreservesColimitsOfShape (Discrete I)
      (rightDerivedLowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) r)) ∧
    Nonempty
      (rightDerivedLowerStarPlus (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) r ⋙
          _root_.DerivedCategory.Plus.ι ≅
        _root_.DerivedCategory.Plus.ι ⋙ rightDerivedLowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) r)
